entries.title: 276th Eng. Co. assumes responsibility from 1223rd Engineers at Kandahar 140424-A-MU632-068.jpg
entries.description: Waterloo, Ill. native, Capt. Phillip Kirk (right), commander of the Pierce City, Mo.-based 276th Engineer Company, attached to the Fort Bragg, N.C.-based 82nd Sustainment Brigade-U.S. Central Command Materiel Recovery Element, and his company first sergeant, Lebanon, Mo.-native, 1st Sgt. Timothy Uptegrove uncase their company colors during an April 24 transfer of authority ceremony with the Summerville, S.C.-based 1223rd Engineer Company at Kandahar Airfield, Afghanistan. Over the course of a nine-month deployment in support of Operation Enduring Freedom, troops with the 276th will work various deconstruction projects and will assist in the transfer of bases to the Government of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan. (U.S. Army photo by Sgt. 1st Class Jon Cupp, 82nd SB-CMRE Public Affairs)
entries.creator: Sgt. 1st Class Jon Cupp

entries.title: Missouri National Guard 1438th Engineer Company 121106-F-RN544-1011.jpg
entries.description: U.S. Missouri National Guard, 1438th Engineer Company 1st Platoon Bridge Company, builds a ferry to transport assets, Jefferson City, Mo., Nov. 6, 2012. The ferry is able to carry vehicles, supplies, and soldiers across large bodies of water. (U.S. Air Force photo by Airman 1st Class Justyn M. Freeman/Released)
entries.creator: Airman 1st Class Justyn Freeman
